import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Check if any feature shows significant association with outcome
    p_values = []
    feature_ids = list(feats.ids)
    
    for i, fid in enumerate(feature_ids):
        x = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
        y = feats.y
        t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(x[y==1], x[y==0], equal_var=False)
        p_values.append(p_val)
    
    # If all p-values > 0.05, no mechanism
    if all(p > 0.05 for p in p_values):
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Find features with p < 0.05 and strong effect
    significant_features = []
    for i, (fid, p_val) in enumerate(zip(feature_ids, p_values)):
        if p_val < 0.05:
            x = feats.x[:, feats.column(fid)]
            diff = np.mean(x[feats.y==1]) - np.mean(x[feats.y==0])
            significant_features.append((fid, abs(diff), p_val))
    
    # Sort by effect size
    significant_features.sort(key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    
    # Select top features
    selected_features = [fid for fid, _, _ in significant_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]]
    
    # Check for correlations above threshold
    correlated_pairs = set()
    for i in range(len(selected_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(selected_features)):
            fid1, fid2 = selected_features[i], selected_features[j]
            col1, col2 = feats.column(fid1), feats.column(fid2)
            corr = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, col1], feats.x[:, col2])[0,1]
            if abs(corr) >= 0.6:
                correlated_pairs.add((min(fid1, fid2), max(fid1, fid2)))
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    to_remove = set()
    for fid1, fid2 in correlated_pairs:
        # Prefer the one with stronger effect
        idx1 = selected_features.index(fid1)
        idx2 = selected_features.index(fid2)
        if idx1 < idx2:
            to_remove.add(fid2)
        else:
            to_remove.add(fid1)
    
    final_features = [fid for fid in selected_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Fit logistic regression to check for interaction effects
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in final_features]]
    lr = LogisticRegression(fit_intercept=True, max_iter=1000)
    lr.fit(X, feats.y)
    
    # Use coefficients as loadings
    loadings = dict(zip(final_features, lr.coef_[0]))
    
    # For simplicity, use just the main effects
    return Design(
        drivers=tuple([fid for fid, _, _ in significant_features[:MAX_DRIVERS]]),
        columns=tuple(final_features),
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
